turnaround_reason: ELEVIDYS gene-therapy patient mortality events in 2025 crushed the stock (~$25 high to ~$14.68 low) and drove a 34% revenue decline; demand is now stabilizing after a strategic restructuring and pipeline prioritization, with ELEVIDYS positioned to return to growth.
bullish_points: Real commercial business: ~$2B TTM revenue and positive operating margin (13%), not a pre-revenue biotech
Commercial portfolio stabilizing; management says ELEVIDYS is positioned to return to growth as ENDEAVOR Cohort 8 (non-ambulatory + sirolimus pretreatment) advances
Cash $788M vs $1.06B debt, current ratio 4.4, positive FCF — no near-term solvency risk
Very high short interest (28.9% of float, 8.2 days to cover) sets up squeeze potential on any good news
Forward P/E ~7 and P/B 1.28 are cheap for a rare-disease franchise with a Roche ELEVIDYS ex-US partnership
Recent EPS beats (Q2 +32%, Q1 +202%) show cost discipline is landing
bearish_points: Gene-therapy safety overhang is existential: any further ELEVIDYS mortality/label restriction can re-break the stock
Revenue still declining YoY (-34%); the 'return to growth' is a forward promise, not yet in the numbers
Dossier news feed was empty (nulls) — thesis leans on SEC/IR filings, not fresh tape
siRNA pipeline (SRP-1001 FSHD, SRP-1003 DM1) is early Phase 1/2a; binary and years from revenue
Sits ~3.6% below its 200-day MA — still basing, breakout unconfirmed
catalyst: ENDEAVOR Cohort 8 full enrollment (non-ambulatory ELEVIDYS expansion) plus Q3 print showing demand stabilization; siRNA Phase 1/2a data
catalyst_timing: Q3 earnings 2026-11-04; ENDEAVOR Cohort 8 full enrollment by year-end 2026; 12-week cohort data Q1 2027
suggested_trade: Spot core position; small Jan-2027 calls acceptable to play the Q1-2027 ENDEAVOR data with defined risk
key_risk: A new ELEVIDYS safety signal or FDA label restriction that reverses the demand-stabilization narrative
would_skip_if: You can't stomach single-headline 30%+ gap risk on gene-therapy safety news; position accordingly or pass
